en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0: \E6* Ooo^1, how's Catti doing^1?&* I have no idea./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0: \E5* We^1, like^1, totally can't connect at all!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0: \E1* Yesterday^1, I asked if she wanted to hear me play the ukelele.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0: \E5* She said no^1!&* And then she^1, like^1, told me.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0: \E3* My playing is "an anti-blessing from Planet Hell."/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0: \E2* That's SOOO cute^1!&* I love my fricked-up lil sis!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1011_0: \E6* Oh^1, you gotta go^1?&* Do you have^1, like^1, homework...?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1012_0: \E0* You should^1, like^1, let me help!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1013_0: \E2* Hahaha^1, JK^1!&* I totally don't want to^1! Laters!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1022_0: \E4* Krissy!&* Like^1, long time no see!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1023_0: \E0* What's up^1?&* Did you wanna talk about something?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1030_0: \E2* Ugh^1, that chick next door drives me NUTS./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1031_0: \E3* I keep seeing her EVERYWHERE I go^1.&* She's a TOTAL copycat./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1032_0: \E5* Like^1, WHY though^1?&* Doesn't she realize she'll NEVER be me?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1033_0: \E6* Honestly^1, her whole family is^1, like^1, SO trashy./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1034_0: \E3* Once her sister served me a coffee and I swear it was half cat fur./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1035_0: \E6* Like^1, get a hairnet^1, girl^1. For^1, like^1, your whole body./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1040_0: \E0* Remember that time you wanted to hang out with us big kids?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1041_0: \E6* I was like, "yeah^1, of course! Just get us some burgers!"/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1042_0: \E3* Then^1, like^1, amazingly..^1.&* You ACTUALLY got them.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1043_0: \E4* So I told you to go back and get some french fries, too.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1045_0: \E6* They were SO good^1, I ate like six!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1046_0: \E3* Then I like..^1.&* Suddenly got so sick I had to go home./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1048_0: \E5* So^1, like^1, anyway..^1.&* Kris^1, are you busy?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1053_0: \E5* Aww^1, that's no way to talk to your almost-sister-in-law./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1055_0: \E0* Remember that time I played truth or dare with Azzy?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1056_0: \E5* I^1, like^1, made him give me his first kiss.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1057_0: \E3* Then your mom found out he kissed someone^1, and.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1058_0: \E6* Like^1, I think she basically dialed 911./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1059_0: \E5* I swear your family went to church^1, like.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1064_0: \E0* Aw^1, Krissy^1, you just wanted to say hi?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1065_0: \E6* That's adorable..^1.&* Now get out of here./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1098_0: \M0* Heheh..^1.&* Just hand over the money^1, and.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1102_0: \M0* You're just like us^1.&* An' people like us gotta help each other out./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1111_0: \M1* HA^1! HA^1! Did I say FIFTY!^1?&* Well^1, we just went on sale!&* TWENTY^1! TWENTY Dark Dollars!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1138_0: \M0* Heheh..^1.&* Just hand over the money^1, and.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1142_0: \M0* You're just like us^1.&* An' people like us gotta help each other out./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1151_0: \M2* ONE!!^1! ONLY ONE DOLLAR!!^1!&* PLEASE!!^1! PLEASE!!^1!&* I NEED THIS RIGHT NOW!!!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1174_0: \M0* Heheh..^1.&* Just hand over the money^1, and.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1178_0: \M0* You're just like us^1.&* An' people like us gotta help each other out./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1188_0: * Er^1, excuse me^1, Sir^1.&* I think I have a dollar./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1194_0: * Heheh^1, perfect^1!&* Right this way^1, gentleners!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0: * I'm TP Master^1.&* Ask me about TP's./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0: * TP^1? What's TP^1?&* That's what lets you cast SPELLS^1, see!?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0: * When you see that orange bar^1,&* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0: * TP...^1! It's quite a caper^1!&* TP^1! Stands for..^1.&* ... Toilet Paper!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0: * ... no^1, it stands for Tension Points./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0: * TP only lasts^1, inside a fight^1.&* Once you win^1, it's out of sight./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0: * Having extra^1, feels unbearable^1.&* No point in saving^1, it's straight-up terrible./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0: \M1* You mean I only should have been using one square!?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0: * You get TP when you DEFEND^1.&* Protect yourself^1, then cast SPELLs^1, friend./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0: * I'm Ralsei Master^1.&* Ask me about RALSEI's./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0: * Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY^1.&* Use it on BABIES^1, before they CRY./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0: * What^1? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1268_0: \M1* What if you're fighting a BABY!?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1273_0: * Ralsei has a spell that HEALS^1, dude./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1274_0: * Why use that^1, when you can eat FOOD?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1276_0: * Because you won't have to use up an ITEM?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1278_0: \M1* I could have avoided all those empty calories!?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1282_0: * Ralsei loves when you give us MONEY./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1283_0: * He will hug you^1, and call you HONEY./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1286_0: \E8* You don't need money to get me to do that!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1295_0: * I'm Susie Master^1.&* Ask me about SUSIE's./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_129_0: * Welcome^1.&* I am the \cYPrince\cW of this \cYKingdom\cW.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_12_0: * You really didn't want to throw it away./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1303_0: * When KRIS uses WARNING^1, SUSIE can't hit^1.&* So make sure to -/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1305_0: * So there's no reason to use it./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1307_0: \M1* Unless..^1.&* Unless you wanted not to hurt -/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1313_0: * Susie's gone^1, I'm afraid^1, I'm afreet./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1318_0: * The days of WARNing^1, have long since past./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_131_0: * Kris^1, Susie..^1.&* There is a \cYLEGEND\cW in this land./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1326_0: * Susie always attacks^1, the foe on top./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1327_0: * She'll smash them^1, with a crushing chop./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1328_0: * She always strikes^1, at the first thing she sees.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_132_0: * A LEGEND that one day^1, two \cYHEROES of LIGHT\cW will arrive,/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1332_0: \M1* Oh no^1, oh no^1!&* She's looking at ME!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1337_0: * Will you two pick up the slack?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_133_0: * And fulfill the ancient prophecy^1, foretold by time and space./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1342_0: * Susie's BUSTER^1, RUDE as may be^1.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1343_0: * Will deal more damage^1, if you just press [~1]!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1349_0: * Susie loves^1, when you give us MONEY^1.&* She will -/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_134_0: * Please^1, Heroes..^1.&* Listen to my tale.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1357_0: * Will you two pick up the slackts?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1361_0: * SUSIE seems to have changed^1, just a hair./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1362_0: * That kind of growth is actually rare./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1378_0: * I'm Kris Master^1.&* Ask me about KRIS's./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1386_0: * When HP goes negative^1, your friends fall down/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1387_0: * But bringing them back^1, is easy-town/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1388_0: * Plain foods and spells^1, work like a charm -/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1389_0: * And with a MINT^1, you can cure all HARM./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1391_0: * Even normal items and spells can revive people^1, huh?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1398_0: * If you only ACT^1, you might start to think -/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1399_0: * What about the guy with the scarf in pink?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1401_0: * If you know ACTing will make the enemy friendly -/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1402_0: * Then you can ask me to SPARE on the SAME TURN./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1403_0: * Or^1, cast PACIFY if you know they'll get TIRED./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1404_0: * If you plan ahead^1, a lot can happen in ONE TURN!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1406_0: \M1* Hey^1, who's the MASTER here^1, me or you!?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1410_0: * It's a good idea^1, to give us BUCKs./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1411_0: * It'll make you happy^1, and fill you with LUCKs./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1412_0: * Over there^1, is our DONATION HOLE./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1413_0: * We had a BOX^1, but it got STOLE./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1423_0: * (If you like our tutorials^1, please throw your money into a hole.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1427_0: * (The hole is filled to the brim with cash.)/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1442_0: * (You failed to budget enough money to throw into a hole...)/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1447_0: * (You decided to save the dollar for a different hole.)/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1459_0: \E2* We^1, uh^1, got bored^1.&* So we're having a snack./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1463_0: * C'mon^1! All I ate for breakfast was chalk!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1467_0: * Sorry^1. What are you two having^1, exactly...?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1469_0: * Just a daily treasure I hid in this stump's orifice./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1473_0: * Feast for yourself^1, my main man./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1475_0: * Kris^1, do you want to^1, um^1, try it?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1493_0: \E1* It's my secret stash^1.&* A little snackeroo from me to you.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1498_0: * C'mon^1, you're just pretending to eat it!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1500_0: * Haha^1, yeah^1! That's what I do^1, too!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1508_0: * (There was a honeypot of salsa inside the stump.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_151_0: \E1* Umm, r-really^1?&* Are you sure^1?&* It's fairly important./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1522_0: * Look^1, if no one else will eat it^1, I'll try it!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1523_0: \E6* ... there's a jar of..^1. Blood...^1?&* In here./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1525_0: * No^1, no^1.&* It's merely a pot of free-range salsa./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1527_0: \E2* Thanks^1, that's actually more gross somehow./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_152_0: * And... um^1, in my opinion^1, it's a really nice \cYPROPHECY\cW!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_153_0: * I think you'd quite like it!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1560_0: \E0* Kris^1, honey^1, you have grown up so much.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1561_0: \E9* Someday soon you will be going off to university as well.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1564_0: \E8* You asked when your horns were going to grow in?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1565_0: \E0* So we bought that headband with the little red horns on it./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1566_0: \E4* Oh^1, you wore it for months! Whatever happened to it?/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1575_0: \E2* Kris^1, I need to grade these assignments./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1576_0: \E0* Perhaps you should go to bed...?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1577_0: \E1* You do not look very well.../%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1592_0: \E4* D..^1. Did you want to talk about something?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1600_0: \E3* O-Oh^1, these flowers...^1? They're from your dad.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1601_0: \E0* He..^1. He always asks how you're doing in school.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1602_0: \E7* ... Then gives me a bouquet of them./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1603_0: \E1* ... A-actually^1, that he always gives me flowers.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1604_0: \E4* ... R-really makes me w-wonder if he..^1. If he l-likes.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1606_0: \EA* ... The awesome comics I lent to him./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1607_0: \EB* Honestly^1, HE kind of reminds me of a superhero^1, Kris./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1608_0: \EA* (He's huge and could kick my ass.)/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1613_0: \E7* I-It's for my kitty^1, MewMew^1! She's a perfect angel!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1614_0: \E3* ... uh^1? What does she look like...?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1615_0: \E9* W..^1. well, I've never actually s-seen her^1, b-but.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1616_0: \E7* Ever since I started putting out milk^1, it's been disappearing./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1617_0: \E6* S..^1. So I'd like to think that there's a cat./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1625_0: \E0* K..^1. Kris^1, even though you never got the chalk.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1626_0: \E0* You deserve an award for trying so hard to find it./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1627_0: \E3* So^1, in return^1, I can let you borrow^1, um.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1628_0: \E0* M... My home-made DVD collection of the Symptons!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1629_0: \E7* Y-you know, the sitcom about the middle-class monster family./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1630_0: \E3* It's got every episode in all 28 seasons!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1631_0: \E0* It's the funniest^1, most quotable show ever...!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1632_0: \E3* But make sure you don't watch past the second season %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1633_0: \E9* Since they just rebooted it as Symptons Turbo %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1634_0: \E8* They all started driving their own motor-vehicles %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1635_0: \E3* And fighting giant giga-demons and stuff %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1636_0: \E9* The main problem about that is that it kind of %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1637_0: \E6* Lost the focus on family that it had earlier %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1638_0: \E7* When their vehicles were shaped like animals %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1639_0: \E5* And they were friends with the animal vehicles too %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1640_0: \E3* And let's not get into Symptons Galaxy Force %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1641_0: \E8* Where the Symptons discover another Earth %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1642_0: \E9* On the other side of the Sun %
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1645_0: \E2* ... You don't want to watch it?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1651_0: \E1* OK^1, umm^1, if you ever need help with homework.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1652_0: \EA* My office hours are in this disgusting alley./

en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9416_0: \E3* What? You saw her drinking milk off the FLOOR?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9417_0: \E0* You should^1, like..^1. tell her there's^1, like^1, milk here./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9418_0: \E4* You know. As..^1. like^1, a cruel prank./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9422_0: \E0* Like^1, where is she? Like^1, let's be honest./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9423_0: \E3* It's not like she has anything better to do than copy me./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9424_0: \E6* I mean^1, she BETTER not^1! God./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9436_0: * Um..^1. how long..^1. should I^1, um..^1. do this for? And^1, is it really.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9438_0: \E4* I mean^1, think of^1, like^1, the good of society^1, right?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9439_0: \E6* Like^1, he was always ogling girls like me and stuff.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9440_0: \E3* Now he can be a good little boy and ogle a jpeg./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9441_0: \E0* See? Everyone wins. Especially US^1, because it's really funny./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9443_0: * W-well^1, I guess it won't hurt to^1, um..^1. if it makes him happy^1, too.../%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9465_0_b: \E0* ..^1. Kris^1, d-did I^1, ever tell you about^1, um.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9466_0_b: \E7* You know^1, I sometimes..^1. put out milk?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9467_0_b: \E4* I..^1. I mean^1, in the alleyway?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9483_0: \E7* Okay^1, well^1, first of all^1, t-there was this cat^1, Mew Mew.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9484_0: \E9* Who^1, um^1, there's no particular evidence she's real^1, but.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9485_0: \E4* You know what? I think that's enough./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_948_0: * (A photo of your mother and father on their wedding day.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9492_0: \E9* I'll forget about this if you do./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_949_0: * (She's holding a bouquet of seven flowers.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9507_0: \E5* ..^1. Kris. You walk. With the accursed beast?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9508_0: \E6* I warn you. You believe. You are holding her leash.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9509_0: \E1* But you. Are the one. Being led into the dark./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_950_0: * (A reindeer-looking monster stands nearby in a tuxedo.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9515_0: \E0* So comes the beast. And its..^1. ...and Kris./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9540_0_b: \E1* Kris. It is too late for you. Your corruption is fatal./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9541_0_b: \E0* But promise. You'll keep away from the light^1, Kris./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9544_0: \EK* Huh? Hey^1, you can hate ME or whatever^1, but.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9545_0: \E0* Noelle can hang out with whoever she wants^1, furball./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9546_0_b: \EA* If you wanted to "protect her^1," shoulda been at church./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9550_0: \E4* Yeah. She invited us to her house. Get over it./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9553_0: \E6* Kris. For long. We have been distant./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9554_0: \E7* But I never imagined. We would be. Enemy clans./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9555_0: \E6* Talk to me. No longer. Goodbye./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9565_0: \E2* To turn the tree^1, into blazing pyre./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9567_0: \E1* After that^1, I'll try. A bigger ladder. Maybe./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9573_0: \E4* Kris..^1. careful. You know not..^1. the forces you betangle./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9600_0: * (It's a book about Monster Funerals. Read it?)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9608_0: * ..^1. When monsters die^1, their dust will be spread over what they loved./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9609_0: * An object that symbolizes their existence. That object will be buried.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9610_0: * And in such a way^1, their soul be able to rest^1, within that object^1, and the earth./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9611_0: * Of course^1, everyone knows that. That's why this is the introduction.../%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9628_0: \E1* Little buddy^1! My DATE's about to start^1! And is it in the BAG./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_962_0: \E4* Lil Krissy!!^1!&* Like, what's up!^1?&* Give Aunt Catty a hug!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9641_0: \E5* TEN DOLLAR flowers. HEART-shaped pizza. And my secret weapon.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9642_0_b: \E3* The ol' duct tape suit I made for prom./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9643_0: \E8* Little Buddy. It's a first date^1, you say. I'm overdoing it^1, you say./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9644_0: \EC* But Pizzarina..^1. I want to show her I'm serious^1! That I..^1. I love her!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9645_0: \E6* And^1, she may be a LITTLE late to our date^1, but..^1. I mean.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9646_0: \EA* LOOK at these MEMES^1^1! A FROG!^1? Riding a BICYCLE!?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9647_0: \E3* If she's breaking out the vintage like this.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9648_0: \EF* She's gotta be making out with me in her mind^1, little buddy.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9649_0: \ED* ..^1. Whoops^1! Another new text^1! Sorry^1, little buddy^1, talk later.../%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_964_0: \E8* Ha ha ha^1!&* I'm not even actually your aunt!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9653_0: \ED* HOT DAMN!!^1! LITTLE BUDDY!!^1! LOOK!^1! LOOK NOW!!!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9654_0_b: \EA* She just edited a meme..^1. to be ABOUT US!!!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9655_0: \EE* My God. This is love. God. I feel it. I feel..^1. the universe!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_965_0: \E5* Oh my god..^1.&* Can I talk to you about something?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9662_0: \E6* Yeah^1, it would be weird if you were here./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_967_0: \E6* Actually^1, like^1, anything^1, though^1.&* Your choice./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_971_0: \E4* Lil Krissy^1!&* Did you wanna talk about something!?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9720_0: * Unfortunately the stop button is the only thing that seems to be broken./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9734_0: * Ahh^1, whatever am I to do..^1. this boredom^1, this ennui.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9735_0: * Ohh my..^1. Is that you again^1, darling? My only "fan".../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9738_0: * Ahh^1, whatever am I to do..^1. this boredom^1, this ennui.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9739_0: * Hm? You must have the wrong house..^1. Now run along and play^1, darling./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9762_0_b: * That's what I thought..^1. Go off and frolick somewhere./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9773_0: * (You hear a hissing sound..^1. Investigate further?)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9781_0: * (Peering into the dark^1, it appears that...)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9782_0: * (The yellow circles in the windows were just fresh donuts.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_980_0: \E2* Oh my god^1, Asriel^1!&* Like^1, what a cutie pie!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_981_0: \E6* Do you remember when me and him went to the dance?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9820_0: \E0* Soon you will meet your demise^1, by the Knight's hand.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9825_0: \E0\M0* ..^1. Aheh. A rare show of mercy^1, I suppose./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9826_0: \E4* With their full strength^1, you'd be SPLATTERED!^1! Hahaha!!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0: \E2* That was like..^1.&* The best night EVER!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0: \E4* Even though I spilled the entire punch bowl all over him.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9849_0: \E6\M5* A little WHAT!? DRAW A PICTURE^1, WENCH!!!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0: \E6* And danced inappropriately in front of your mom.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0: \E5* And got arrested in the parking lot for making a scene.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9861_0_b: \E5* It was he^1, the clown^1, that told me the Knight's brilliance.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9862_0: \E0* About the fountains' glory^1, and how I would rise to power./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9863_0: \E7* Funny little man. How his jokes and dances made us chuckle./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9864_0: \E5* A shame he had to be tricked away^1, by his closest companion./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9865_0: \E5* The magician^1, Seam^1, whose smile has gone empty since that day./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0: \E2* Hahaha^1! That was SO much fun^1!&* Tell him I said hi!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9876_0: \E0* There you two are^1! I hope you have been.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9882_0: \M0\E5* Kris^1, Susie is the guest. Make an excuse for her./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0: \E1* Like^1, that green girl next door?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9913_0: * (Zig zag rug..^1. flatscreen TV..^1. regular-looking kitchen...)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9914_0: * (..^1. it's a bit messy^1, but nothing special.)/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0: \E5* Oh my god^1, Krissy^1.&* She's like..^1. my LIFE VILLAIN./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0: \E6* Like^1, the other day^1, I went to see Cat Petters 2.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0: \E3* And the only other person in the theater was her!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0: \E1* Then I went to QC's and ordered a Catpuccino.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0: \E5* And she^1, like^1, was already drinking one!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0: \E3* She's SUCH a copycat^1!&* ... uhh^1, copygator?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9972_0: * A pleasure seeing you young'uns here^1! Whatcha need?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9983_0_b: * If you're looking for wares^1, I've got a fair share./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9984_0: * Take a gander at that table down there^1! Wahaha!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9985_0: * Everything in this study's mine^1, so lots for sale^1, lots for sale!/%

en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7512_0: * RECRUITs will appear in your TOWN. Wonder what happens if you get them all...?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0: * You can check the area's RECRUIT status at SAVE POINTS. Certain BOSSES are excluded./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0: * You will now have access to a STORAGE menu at SAVE POINTS./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0: * When you're out of space^1, ITEMs you find or BUY will be sent to your STORAGE./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0: * Feel free to put things inside you might not be able to use yet./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7527_0: * Here is a reminder of the controls. Change them in the config menu./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7529_0: * ~1&* Cancel. Hold to RUN. Shows all text instantly./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7530_0: * ~1&* Opens the menu. Hold down to quickly skip textboxes./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7554_0: * Oh^1, Kris^1! It's a free editable CYBERPEDIA^1! I'll add an entry...!/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7556_0: * (Ralsei wrote an article about LOSING RECRUITS. Read it?)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_757_0: * (Your fingers don't fit through the top anymore.^1)&* (You try from below.)/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7582_0: * From now on^1, defeating enemies with violence will make them LOST./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0: * LOST enemies cannot become RECRUITs ever again./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0: * But^1, the bonds you break may make you stronger.../%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_758_0: * (... your hand became covered in cobwebs.)/%

en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7849_0: * ..^1. but^1, you gotta be a trio./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7850_0: * Hey^1, boss^1. We^1, uh..^1. we kind of stopped fitting in^1, at the dojo./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7850_0_b: * Get that Susie girl over here!/%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7851_0: * So all of us rejects started a new battle frontier..^1. here^1. In the bakery./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7853_0: * What do you say^1, boss^1? Want to try?/
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7856_0: * ..^1. well^1, I'd like to ask you to fight^1, boss but it seems.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7857_0_b: * ..^1. you didn't RECRUIT everyone up until now./
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7858_0: * One of our guys's got a moral objection to that. Sorry^1, boss./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7871_0: * No battles today^1, boss. Today's pacifists only./%
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7872_0: * Boss^1! You fought everybody we had today.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7873_0: * Well..^1. I was thinkin' of making a trio^1, too^1, but.../
en.scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7874_0_b: * Maybe that's not a great idea right now./%
